evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce ReFigBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework built on 1,000 real overview figures retrieved from arXiv papers with full provenance.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We study scientific overview figure reconstruction, an agent task in which a source image must become an editable PowerPoint slide that preserves text, topology, layout, and native document structure.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation combines deterministic artifact checks, repeated automated scoring by judges from two model families, and blinded human comparisons.
